title: Sliding Window Maximum (VecDeque)
prompt:
Given a slice of integers and a window size k, return the maximum of every contiguous window of size k, from left to right.

Your solution should run in O(n) using a std::collections::VecDeque as a monotonic queue of indices: keep indices whose values are in decreasing order, pop from the back while the new value is >= the back's value, and pop from the front when the front index falls out of the window.

If k == 0 or k > nums.len(), return an empty Vec.

Example:
  sliding_max(&[1, 3, -1, -3, 5, 3, 6, 7], 3) -> [3, 3, 5, 5, 6, 7]
  sliding_max(&[4, 2], 1) -> [4, 2]
